meta.title: Service Master Import: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and attempt Service Master Import to verify it is refused or absent.
Repeat Service Master Import as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available.
Compare the two role-specific outcomes in the same tenant.
